title: F106 restore readiness consistency
canonical_summary: Reject ready_for_owner_activation in the existing backup JJ restore-verification receipt when workspace_map_result is collision_blocked, colocation_activation_disposition is blocked_dual_writer_or_identity_collision, or working_copy_relation is unverified.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not claim a proven unsafe runtime activation.
Do not add an event, command, handler or Backup owner.
Do not adopt automatic rollback or degraded recovery.
Do not infer that every non-colocated owner-rebind disposition is invalid; only explicit blockers and an unverified relation are demonstrated.

title: F107 graph page consistency and adjacency bounds
canonical_summary: Require relational page consistency in the existing SourceGraph contract: returned_count equals the emitted node count and does not exceed page_size or the 200-node cap, a current page declaring has_more carries a usable continuation, node_ref is unambiguous within a page, and parent-reference expansion is finite.
gui_classification_reason: SourceGraph is the typed model behind the virtualized Source Control history-and-graph view, so page count, continuation, node identity and adjacency consistency are directly user-visible; the owner SCS-017 is gui_related: true.
negative_constraints: Do not claim a GG or Puppet Master runtime failure, performance result or integration regression.
Do not require every parent reference to be present in the same page; cross-page ancestry is legitimate.
Do not impose a one-parent or probe-derived exact parent cap.
Do not generalize the current-page continuation rule to unavailable, partial or error pages.
Do not count cursor ownership or selection transition tests as separately discovered defects.

title: F108 clone identity before native initialization
canonical_summary: Let the existing Jujutsu clone request and result represent the legitimate destination-not-yet-initialized phase without fabricated native commit, change, operation or snapshot identities, while initialized repository operations retain their exact native fences.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not claim a shipping clone failure or a runtime certification.
Do not waive existing-repository native fencing or pass --at-op to native clone.
Do not manufacture an initial operation through a separate pre-init mutation to satisfy a request shape.
Do not treat receipt nullability as a fourth correction; it is existing F001 support.
Do not add a new closed stage or settlement record; that needs separate owner design.

title: F109 required transport credential evidence
canonical_summary: Require the neutral credential_lease to carry use_http_path for HTTPS and both known_hosts_receipt_ref and forwarding_disabled for SSH, retaining the existing true and non-empty constraints.
gui_classification_reason: Machine-contract correction to an existing backend obligation; the broader owner PlanUnits keep their own GUI classification.
negative_constraints: Do not claim a demonstrated live credential leak, authentication bypass or runtime security proof.
Do not treat a non-empty known-host reference as proof its referent exists or is current.
Do not add a broker, raw askpass path, secret-bearing field, command, persisted record or ambient fallback.
Do not make opposite-transport fields mandatory.
